description: How a runner must classify each typed daemon refusal in this directory (<code>.json, generated from the real TypeScript builders by scripts/generate-refusal-wire-fixtures.ts). wait = wait for the device within the bounded device wait; acquire-new-session = retry under a fresh session UUID; retry = ordinary bounded retry; fail = fail the attempt. Precedence when a runner derives it: wait, then acquire-new-session (nextAction), then retry (retryable: true), else fail. knownGaps maps a runner (kotlin, swift) to the disposition it currently produces instead of the expected one, so the suite stays green while the gap is tracked; a gap that starts matching the expectation fails the suite until the entry is removed.
